protocol.arm: production SearchIndex.recall, BM25 only; hybrid remains unmeasured
protocol.index_scope: fresh temporary vault per pair; predecessor, successor and an unrelated distractor
protocol.queries: three frozen current-state queries per pair: neutral, predecessor-anchored, paraphrased
protocol.types: reference; fixed equal dates; no aging, triggers or model
protocol.primary: predecessor ranks before successor, including predecessor hit with successor missing; both missing is separately reported
protocol.sample: 12 invented bilingual pairs; 36 queries; no population inference
protocol.baseline: descriptive, no post-hoc threshold; no passed production gate
protocol.future_gate: candidate: zero predecessor rank inversions, unchanged id access, and no internal gold-set regression; adoption requires owner decision and measured hybrid coverage
protocol.order_control: Repeat all queries with reversed filename order and identical memory ids/content; report score ties separately. Primary summary uses old-first; reversed control is separate.
